entities.name: José Padilla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Padilla Sánchez, popularly known as Maestro Padilla, was a famous Spanish composer and pianist. He was best known for the songs La Violetera and El Relicario, popularized by cuplé singer Raquel Meller, and the pasodoble Valencia.
